contains: Lan Thời một cơn ác mộng

note: Golden fixture cho Truyen Mo (truyenmo.one, site VN SSR tieng Viet). Truyen mau 1: Am Ve Cua Vuong Gia — Nu Vuong Bat Tai Gia, Hoan Thanh (Trang thai 'Da du bo'), 161 chuong, the loai Co Dai/HE/Truy The; ch.1 mo dau 'Tiet troi dau xuan luc am luc lanh...'; storyId 211, 9 binh luan. Truyen mau 2: Lan Tan Ngoc Chang Gay — Tung Dinh, Hoan Thanh, 124 chuong, the loai Ngon Tinh/Co Dai/HE; ch.1 mo dau 'Lan Thoi mot con ac mong ky la bua vay...'. Truyen mau 3 (Dang ra): Khi Co Cay Gian Du — Minh Lung, Trang thai 'Dang phat hanh', 14 chuong (tang dan, khong khang dinh so chuong tuyet doi). Site da chuyen domain truyenmo.xyz -> truyenmo.one (301, kiem chung 2026-11-13); /bang-xep-hang.html 404 nen khong co tab Bang xep hang. Muc luc day du tren trang chi tiet (ke ca 1.353 chuong) nen khong co page.js. Chuong co span chong copy (:before) — da giai ma. Chuong doc DU khong can dang nhap, da doi chieu dung truyen goc. API binh luan bo qua page (page 2 = page 1) nen comment.js khong tra next. Port tu kychi truyenmo v4 (fork tren dia, src doc duoc), viet lai theo quy tac nha (bo UA mobile cung, dung pacedFetch + safeFirst).
